text.zh:
人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、毒素及其亚单位、动物 “ 病原微生物”：
说明：
1．1C351 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，以及含有此类 “ 病原微生物”的各种生物材料（例如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料 ； 无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C351 项所管制的各种“毒素”，不包括免疫用毒素，以及经国家主管部门批准的人或动物用药物产品。
3．1C351 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对人、动物健康造成严重损害的人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、动物“病原微生物”。
b．立克次体：
2．巴通体（也称五日热巴通体、昆氏立克次体）Bartonella quintana（syn.Rochalimea quintana，Rickettsia quintana）；
text.en: Human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms,” toxins and their subunits, and animal “pathogenic microorganisms”: Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C351 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures, as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. The “toxins” controlled under 1C351 exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health. b. Rickettsiae: 2. Bartonella quintana (syn. Rochalimea quintana, Rickettsia quintana);

text.zh: 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的或作涂层的坩埚
text.en: Crucibles made of or coated with materials resistant to liquid actinide metals

text.zh:
用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的坩埚：
a．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积150～8000 cm³ 或150～8000 ml；
2．用总不纯度小于等于2%（按重量计）的以下任何一种材料或以下材料组合制造的或作涂层：
a．氟化钙（CaF₂）；
b．锆酸钙（偏锆酸盐）（CaZrO₃）；
c．硫化铈（Ce₂S₃）；
d．氧化铒（Er₂O₃）；
e．氧化铪（HfO₂）；
f．氧化镁（MgO）；
g．氮化铌-钛-钨合金（约50%铌、30%钛和20%钨）；
h．氧化钇（Y₂O₃）；
i．氧化锆（ZrO₂）；
text.en: Crucibles made of materials resistant to liquid actinide metals: a. Crucibles having both of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 150–8000 cm³ or 150–8000 ml; 2. Made of or coated with any of the following materials, or combinations thereof, with a total impurity content of 2% or less by weight: a. Calcium fluoride (CaF₂); b. Calcium zirconate (metazirconate) (CaZrO₃); c. Cerium sulfide (Ce₂S₃); d. Erbium oxide (Er₂O₃); e. Hafnium oxide (HfO₂); f. Magnesium oxide (MgO); g. Nitrided niobium–titanium–tungsten alloy (approximately 50% niobium, 30% titanium, and 20% tungsten); h. Yttrium oxide (Y₂O₃); i. Zirconium oxide (ZrO₂);

text.zh:
用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿 2 个或多个轴同时进行 “ 成形控制 ”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：注意 ： 由 2B201项附属软件控制的“数控”单元，见 2D203 项。
说明：1 ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后，根据以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”水平，如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可，可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”：
a．选择某一型号 5 台机器以供评价；b ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，测量直线坐标 “ 精度”；
c．测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值（A）。ISO230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法；
d．测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的 “ 定位精度 ”（Âx，Ây……）；e ． 既然2B201
text.en: Machine tools for removing or cutting metals, ceramics or composites, and any combination thereof, which, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous "contouring control" in two or more axes: Attention: For "numerical control" units controlled by software associated with 2B201, see 2D203. Notes: 1. Claimed “positioning accuracy” levels obtained using the following “procedure,” after measurement in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machine tools if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. Determine the claimed “positioning accuracy” using the following “procedure”: a. Select five machines of a model for evaluation; b. Measure linear-axis “accuracy” in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. Determine the accuracy value (A) for each axis of each machine. ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. Determine the average accuracy value for each axis. this average may become the claimed “positioning accuracy” for each axis of that machine model (Âx, Ây…); e. Since 2B201

text.zh:
项提到每个直线坐标，因此将会得出与线性轴数同样多的声称的 “ 定位精度 ”值；
f．如果不受 2B201.a 、2B201.b 或2B201.c 项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称“定位精度”，对磨床而言小于等于 6 µm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于 8µm（两者均按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定），则应要求制造商每 18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。
2．2B201 项不管制限于加工以下部件的专用机床:
a．齿轮；
b．曲轴或凸轮轴；
c．工具或刀具；
d．挤压机螺杆。
技术说明：
1．轴应根据国际标准（ ISO841 《 数控机床 —— 轴和动作的名称》）或等效国家标准命名。
2．二次平行轴的数量成形未计入成形轴的总数量。（例如：在水平镗床上的 w轴或中心线与一次转轴平行的二次转轴）。
3．旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。
4．就 2B201项而言，可同时协调的 “
text.en: refers to each linear axis, there will be as many claimed “positioning accuracy” values as there are linear axes; f. If any axis of a machine tool not controlled by 2B201.a, 2B201.b, or 2B201.c has a claimed “positioning accuracy” of 6 µm or less for grinding machines, or 8 µm or less for milling or turning machines (both measured in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard), the manufacturer must be required to redetermine the accuracy level every 18 months. 2. 2B201 does not control special-purpose machine tools limited to manufacturing the following parts: a. Gears; b. Crankshafts or camshafts; c. Tools or cutters; d. Extruder screws. Technical Notes: 1. Axes must be designated in accordance with the international standard ISO841, “Numerically Controlled Machines — Axis and Motion Nomenclature,” or an equivalent national standard. 2. Secondary parallel contouring axes are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. (For example, the w-axis on a horizontal boring mill or a secondary rotary axis whose centerline is parallel to the primary rotary axis.) 3. Rotary axes need not rotate through 360 degrees. A rotary axis may be driven by a linear device, such as a screw or rack and pinion. 4. For 2B201, the number of simultaneously coordinated axes for “

text.zh:
成形控制 ”的轴数是指在加工中沿这些轴或围绕这些轴可实现工件与刀具间同时且有关联的运动的轴数。这不包括任何其他的轴，沿这些轴或围绕这些轴在车床上实现其他有关运动，例如：
a．磨床的轮装置系统；
b．用来装卸其他工件的平行旋转轴；
c．用来从不同端点将同一工件装入卡盘的共线旋转轴；
5．具有车、铣、磨 3 个功能中2 个或 2 个以上功能（如车床具有铣的功能）的工具，要分别以2B201.a、2B201.b和 2B201.c 项加以评估。
6．2B201.b.3、2B201.c.3 项管制基于平行线性动力学设计，具有5 个或更多非旋转轴的机床 （ 例如：并联机床）。
a．具有以下两种特性的车床：
1．能够加工件直径大于 35 mm 的车床；
2．按照 ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6µm（总“定位精度”）；
说明：2B201.a 项不管制仅加工贯穿进给的棒料，
text.en: contouring control” means the number of axes along or about which simultaneous and interrelated motion between the workpiece and tool can occur during machining. This excludes any other axes along or about which other related movements are performed on a lathe, for example: a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines; b. Parallel rotary axes for loading or unloading other workpieces; c. Collinear rotary axes for holding the same workpiece in a chuck from different ends; 5. Machine tools having two or more of the three functions of turning, milling, and grinding (e.g., a turning machine with milling capability) must be evaluated separately against 2B201.a, 2B201.b, and 2B201.c. 6. 2B201.b.3 and 2B201.c.3 control machine tools based on parallel linear kinematic designs with five or more non-rotary axes (e.g., parallel-kinematic machine tools). a. Turning machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. Turning machines capable of machining workpieces with diameters greater than 35 mm; 2. “Positioning accuracy,” with all available compensation, better than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; Note: 2B201.a does not control bar turning machines limited to machining through-fed bar stock,

text.zh: 棒料最大直径小于等于 42 mm，并且无法安装卡盘能力的棒料车床。车床可对直径小于 42 mm 的加工零件进行钻、铣加工。
text.en: with a maximum bar diameter of 42 mm or less, and having no capability to fit a chuck. The machines may drill or mill parts with diameters less than 42 mm.
